# Psalm 64 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 64:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 64:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Hear my-voice, O-God, in-my-complaint; from-the-dread of-the-enemy preserve my-life.
- **LOGOS:** Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
- **PNEUMA:** O God, listen to my complaint. Protect my life from my enemies' threats.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 64:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Hide-me from-the-counsel of-evildoers, from-the-tumult of-workers of-iniquity,
- **LOGOS:** Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, from the throng of evildoers,
- **PNEUMA:** Hide me from the plots of this evil mob, from this gang of wrongdoers.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 64:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** They-search-out injustices: 'We-have-completed a-searched-out search!' And-the-inward-part of-a-man and-the-heart [is] deep.
- **LOGOS:** They search out injustice, saying, 'We have accomplished a diligent search.' For the inward mind and heart of a man are deep.
- **PNEUMA:** As they plot their crimes, they say, 'We have devised the perfect plan!' Yes, the human heart and mind are cunning.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 64:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-all men fear and-declare the-work of-God, and-His-deed they-understand.
- **LOGOS:** Then all mankind fears; they tell what God has brought about and ponder what He has done.
- **PNEUMA:** Then everyone will be filled with awe. They will tell what God has done; they will learn from His great deeds.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 64:6 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** They-strengthen for-themselves an-evil purpose; they-talk of-hiding snares; they-say, 'Who sees-them?'
- **LOGOS:** They hold fast to their evil purpose; they talk of laying snares secretly, thinking, 'Who can see us?'
- **PNEUMA:** They encourage each other to do evil and plan how to set their traps in secret. 'Who will ever notice?' they ask.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
